chapter: Charlie Johnson, Willie Gant and the late 1920s
title: Playing in the Village for gangsters
summary: He worked Greenwich Village bands where gangsters ran the clubs.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Oh, I'm -- when I left Willie, I went down in the Village to work, different ones, had the gangster bands group down there with the (unintelligible). They had all the
(unintelligible) sewed up then. So I went down to work about different ants a month. A lot of the gangsters I knew them, and you had to play the saxophone (unintelligible) for them.
